claims: As of early April 2026, Seattle Mariners home games were rescheduled to accommodate the Seahawks' Week 1 home opener on a Wednesday night at T-Mobile Park.
The Mariners and Sounders rearranged games to avoid conflict with the Seahawks' schedule.
The 2025 ALDS took place in October 2025.
Rain caused substantial delays in the 2025 ALDS.
A game in Detroit was delayed for nearly three hours.
The Mariners have a game in Anaheim April 3-5.
